title: Google employee charged with $1M Polymarket insider trading bet on search term
summary: A Google employee has been charged with insider trading after allegedly placing $1 million in bets on Polymarket, a crypto prediction market platform, using confidential internal search trend data to gain an unfair advantage on future events.
problem_solved: This case highlights the risks of insider trading and misuse of privileged corporate data access for personal financial gain in prediction markets.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary tale about data security, insider trading risks, and the need for stricter controls on employees with access to sensitive market-moving information.
